# Mazy Nail Studio

> Custom nail art studio based in Austin, Texas. Hand-painted custom nail art by Mazy and Vincent in Montopolis, southeast Austin. Show us any inspiration photo and we'll make it even better than the original.

## Services
- Hand-painted nail art: Bring a screenshot, a Pinterest board or just a vibe. Mazy paints it by hand, from cartoon characters to porcelain florals.
- Chrome, cat eye & French: Glassy chrome, rainbow aura, red cat eye, chrome French and soft nudes with a little sparkle.
- Extensions & overlays: Lightweight Gel-X, hard gel, dual-form, acrylic and poly-gel, shaped clean, with refills when you grow out.
- Gel & Russian manicures: A classic gel manicure, a builder gel for strength, or a detailed Russian e-file manicure.
- Pedicures with Vincent: From a classic pedi to the Milk & Honey and the organic herbal detox. Vincent's pedicures are a client favorite.
- 4-Hands with Mazy & Vincent: Short on time? Mazy and Vincent work together: manicure and pedicure at the same time, in about an hour.

## About
Mazy Nail Studio opened in 2025 on Montopolis Drive in southeast Austin. It's Mazy and Vincent's own space, built after years of clients following them from salon to salon. Mazy never planned to become a nail tech, until she fell in love with creating trend-setting designs. Today she paints everything by hand, from Coraline and Spirited Away to porcelain florals and fruit, and posts her sets as @nail.bymazy. Bring her any inspiration photo and she'll make it even better than the original. Vincent is the gentle, precise half of the duo, known for clean shaping and the pedicures clients rave about. Together they keep things clean, on time and fun: "your friends, your therapists and your creative partners."

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through our GlossGenius page, where you can see the full menu and open times. You can also call or text (346) 971-7801.
- Q: How much is a custom set?
  A: Simple designs (chrome, French tips, cat eye) start at $95 for a new set. Intricate hand-painted designs start at $125 (level 1) and go up with time and detail. Full prices are on our Services page.
- Q: Can I bring an inspiration photo?
  A: Yes, please do. For detailed designs, send your inspo 1-2 days before your appointment so Mazy can confirm she can create it and how long it will take.
- Q: What is the 4-Hands service?
  A: Mazy and Vincent work on you at the same time: a manicure and a pedicure in about 1 to 1.5 hours. Perfect when you're short on time.
- Q: What's your cancellation policy?
  A: Please cancel at least 24 hours ahead. Cancellations inside 24 hours and no-shows are charged 30% of the service.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 1700 Montopolis Dr, Suite B, Austin, TX 78741, in Montopolis just off Riverside in southeast Austin. Open Monday to Friday 10 am to 6 pm and Saturday 11 am to 5 pm.
